notes: DongleToken (src/DongleToken.sol) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC20 v5.1.0 named Dongle, symbol DONGLE, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 DONGLE (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, the launch factory, which pays every allocation out of that balance. The token has no owner, no roles, no mint, burn, burnFrom, pause, blacklist, freeze, lock, seize or transfer toggle, no fee or burn on transfer, no external calls in the constructor, no receive or fallback, no proxy, no delegatecall and no selfdestruct, so every launch flow (distributor, pool seed, swaps) moves exactly what it says and the supply can never grow after deployment. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The pool pairs with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 at the launch policy's 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (4,500 IMD for the whole supply) and totalSupply. Economics are the requester's: 88% of the supply seeds the pool and the remainder of the requester's share goes to 0xff3e8d9ba776662ca6ed1420ee366afb436d2684.
